title: Three Years and One Short Lever
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：switch　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 switch 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1972 the engineer ① fitted the switch that no worker in the workshop would have counted, and he said the fitting was the whole of the year. The ② switch, meaning the button itself and not the lever, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a switch, he said, is the only thing in a workshop that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ switch in that workshop had the same short lever beside it, and the ④ switch at the far bench, meaning the part they kept for the children to fit and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A switch, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the engineer said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the switch was the whole of the matter, meaning the choice and not the button. The ⑥ switch, meaning the choice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; switch, he said, is either something you fit or the only word that means both a button and a choice. He said the choice is the part they remember.

By 1977 the ⑦ switch had become a line in a manual, and the manual had become an argument about the short lever. The ⑧ switch of the whole thing, the engineer wrote in April, was one workshop and three years of counting; switch, he said, is either the part at the far bench or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ switch I remember is the button counted in the manual, which closed in 1979 and is still counted as the quietest in the workshop. A ⑩ switch, my mother said in 1981, is the only button that improves by being counted; every switch, she said, is a choice that has agreed to look like a button. She said the choice was the honest half.

answers.why: fit the switch 意为“装这一个开关”，1972 年那位工程师把车间里没有一位工人肯清点的一个开关做了一遍。
switch 意为“开关；转换”，指那个开关本身而不是短短的拉杆，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
switch 意为“开关；转换”，指车间里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一根短短的拉杆。
switch 意为“开关；转换”，指最远那张工作台的留给孩子们装的那一件，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
switch 意为“开关、转圜”，指一件事里人人都用却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个转圜就是那件事的全部。
switch 意为“转圜”，指人人都用却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个开关，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
switch 意为“开关；转换”，指说明书里写到、被清点的那一个，到 1977 年这一个成了说明书里的一行。
switch 意为“开关之事”，工程师四月写道，整件事的开关之事是一处车间和三个年头的清点。
switch 意为“开关；转换”，我记得的是说明书里清点过的那一个，1979 年装好了，至今仍被说成车间里最安静的一个。
switch 为抽象总称，母亲 1981 年说，开关是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的开关。
